native_install_mechanism: Cursor project rule plus SessionStart hook registered from hooks/hooks-cursor.json
supported_runtime_versions: Cursor with Project Rules and hook support
install: Commit .cursor/rules/super-build-kit.mdc and register hooks/hooks-cursor.json through Cursor's plugin mechanism.
update: Update the rule, Kernel, and hook files in the repository; Cursor re-reads them next session.
uninstall: Remove the Cursor rule and hook registration. Nothing outside the project is modified.
rollback: Restore the previous rule and hook files from version control.
limitations: If native hook registration is unavailable, activation degrades to the always-on rule and is recorded as T2.
deprecation: None. Adapter is active and supported.
